segments.sn56.18:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn56.18:1.5: “Yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, dukkhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, vijjā;
segments.sn56.18:2.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhu,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.
